tha-ap40:1.1: Āyāgadāyaka.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Sikhimhi vadataṃ vare / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena avandiṃ thūpam uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:2.1: Vaḍḍhakehi kathāpetvā mūlan datvān' ahaṃ tadā / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena āyāgaṃ kārapes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:3.1: Aṭṭhakappāni devesu abbhocchinnaṃ vasim ahaṃ / avasesesu kappesu vokiṇṇaṃ saṃsarim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:4.1: Kāye visaṃ na kamati satthāni *na ca ha*nti me / udake 'haṃ na miyyāmi āyāgassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:5.1: Yad' icchāmi ahaṃ vassaṃ mahāmegho pavassati / devā pi me vasaṃ enti puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:6.1: Sataratanasampanno tiṃsakkhattuṃ ahos' ahaṃ / na maṃ kecāvajānanti puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:7.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe āyāgaṃ yam akārayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi āyāgassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap40:8.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap40:9.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Āyāgodāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
